text:
Maria: quick ping — PR #8412 is ready for merge if we can get 2 approvals. CI passed but the canary run shows a tail latency bump. attaching bench summary and raw link. please react if you want a hold :eyes:
CI-bot: CI ✅ all checks passed on main and branch (unit, lint, integration). canary started at 3615123500.
Maria: bench snapshot:
```
baseline (main): p50 12ms p95 48ms p99 120ms mem 1.8GB
this branch : p50 13ms p95 68ms p99 210ms mem 1.92GB
delta: p95 +20ms (+42%), p99 +90ms (+75%), mem +120MB
cmd: ./bench --model longseq --batch 4 --iters 100 --seed 42
link: https://internal.redwood/bench/3615123456
```
Jon: can you paste per-shard / per-core breakdown? p99 jump looks concentrated or spread?
Maria: sure — raw CSV here: https://internal.redwood/bench/3615123456/raw.csv  (shows p99 spikes on shard 3 and 7)
Akash: looking. initial thought: alloc path changed in this PR — might be extra copying in kv-shard hot path. can we rerun with `--batch 2` and `--prefill-kv 1` to see diff? small batches often hide the issue.
Maria: rerunning now with batch=2, prefill-kv=1. I'll post results in ~20m.
Sam: heads up — canary currently has 3% errors on tail requests, not sure if user-facing. I'd prefer to hold merge until we confirm rerun fixes p99 or we add a mitigator fallback.
Taylor: I can give one approval if we add a canary fallback that routes longseq requests to the previous variant for 24h. otherwise hold. :+1:
Maria: noted. proposed fallback config snippet:
```yaml
route: longseq
fallback_variant: longseq-v1.3.2
threshold: p99 > 180ms -> route fallthrough
window: 24h
```
Maria: rerun results (batch=2):
```
this branch batch=2: p50 12ms p95 50ms p99 128ms mem 1.86GB
delta vs baseline: p95 +2ms, p99 +8ms, mem +60MB
```
Akash: that's encouraging — smaller batch reduces the tail. suggests batching interaction with kv-copy. I can follow up with a microdiff to avoid the extra copy.
Jon: thanks. I'll +1 once the microdiff PR lands or the fallback config is staged.
CI-bot: Canary status: after rerun, canary p99 below threshold, errors <0.5%, canary mark: PASS at 3615123585.
Sam: ok holding removed, @Taylor you still good with merging?
Taylor: approve. please open a follow-up issue to land the micro-optim and link the bench artifacts. :rocket:
Maria: will do — merging in ~10m and filing issue RW-1254 with artifacts. thanks all :heart:
